name: Stimulus example — two pictures and a short video
notes: Shows the stimuli task: images and video named by sha256, shown in a
seeded order with a fixation cross between them, each onset stamped when
it is painted. The files are self-generated (tools/make_stimuli.py).
scene_left and scene_right are mirror images, so the same two AOIs swap
sides — the simplest check that per-stimulus gaze results follow the
picture rather than the screen. A developer self-test (no audience).

disclosure.secondary_use: Analysed by the named research team only. Not sold, and not shared outside the team without a further, separate agreement.
